card.name: Owlbear Cub
card.oracle_text: Mama's Coming — Whenever this creature attacks a player who controls eight or more lands, look at the top eight cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and attacking that player. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

rule_design.intervening_if: Defending player's land count (CR 603.4), evaluated when attackers are declared and again as the trigger resolves; TriggerCondition::DefendingPlayerControlsEightOrMoreLands.
rule_design.look_not_search: CR 701.20a. Pending::SearchLibrary gains a `looked` list so 'the rest' is the examined cards only; finish_look_at_top randomises only those and puts them under the library (CR 701.20e). No shuffle; the rest of the library keeps its order.
rule_design.attacking_but_not_declared: The put creature is appended to turn.attackers so it deals combat damage, and deliberately NOT to turn.declared_attackers: CR 508.1 makes 'attacked' a declaration and CR 506.5 reads 'the only creature declared as an attacker'. slice47/NEXT-CARDS-BRIEF.md suggested recording it in both; that would have stopped the Cub counting as having attacked alone, so it is overridden and tested.
rule_design.validate: GameState::validate requires the looked set to be exactly the top of the library in order, only creature cards among it to be eligible, and at most one card to be put.

disclosures: Original #17 remains UNFINISHED: 1 of 8 lists certified, Ayula 5 names missing (Dunadan Rangers, Evercoat Ursine, Rampaging Yao Guai, Ruxa Patient Professor, Ursine Monstrosity). No 100-card certification.

The Cub journey is a 40-card package driven by an evidence-only masked demonstrator: not a 100-card certificate, not product AI and not a strength claim. Its eight-land conditions arose from lands accumulated in normal play, not a staged board.

Implementation-first, disclosed: the engine code was written before the test file, so the two retained REDs are post-hoc discriminating controls, not pre-implementation failing tests. This increment must not be described as TDD.
CI on the code head 3e7675a was cancelled by later pushes; no CI pass is claimed for 3e7675a. The evidence tip's own run is the one to read.

The intervening-if resolution re-check is implemented but has no dedicated test: arranging a defender whose land count drops below eight while the trigger is on the stack needs a destruction path this card's package does not give the test harness cheaply. Disclosed rather than claimed.
A creature put onto the battlefield tap-attacking is not covered by the legend rule (CR 704.5j, still unimplemented) or by the CR 903.9a commander-return deviation; both are unchanged.
Prior reviewer artifacts and the modified saved-session JSONL remain untracked/uncommitted.
